description: Source code for the Scope interface and its implementation in the Kubernetes Topology Manager, managing pod topology hints, container mappings, and policies.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Interface for managing topology hints, policies, and container mappings within the Topology Manager.

classes.name: scope
classes.description: Implementation of the Scope interface, managing internal state such as hints, policies, and container mappings.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the scope.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Determines if a pod can be admitted based on the topology policy.

methods.name: AddHintProvider
methods.description: Adds a hint provider to the scope.

methods.name: AddContainer
methods.description: Tracks a container within the scope.

methods.name: RemoveContainer
methods.description: Removes a container from the scope tracking.

methods.name: admitPolicyNone
methods.description: Implements admission logic when topology policy is 'none'.

methods.name: allocateAlignedResources
methods.description: Allocates resources for a container using registered hint providers.
